items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: we did a concert in Groningen, Holland, in '76

ctx.x: visited the Vanguard. You might say a little bit about that.

Well, you know, you told me that Dexter was in town, so I knew Dexter since 1941 when he was with Lionel Hampton and then his father was Duke Ellington's doctor. His father was a doctor. And so, you know, I knew Dexter through the years and we did a concert in Groningen, Holland, in '76, I think it was and we spoke briefly. But when I came back to New York and he was at the Village Vanguard, you told me he'd be there, and we had the night off before I went to work. And it was just a wonderful evening. Dexter was…
What was that, at the Sweet Basil? I saw him; he sounded good.
